validation_window.description: 72 h before through 24 h after deterministic landfall reference

pathway_definition.meaning: Candidate rainfall-driven surface-water pathway context; thresholds are screening parameters, not calibrated damage probabilities.

sar_overlap_context.warning: This is an area ratio, not a probability or causal attribution.

interpretation: Rainfall, terrain and land-cover layers provide independent physical context for interpreting SAR change.
The pathway mask is not ground truth and does not prove causality.
The broad AOI includes inland and coastal areas; infrastructure-level validation should use a tighter impact AOI.
Storm surge is not represented by this rainfall pathway layer; a separate coastal water-level/surge model is required.
